name: – Rasa Juknevičienė – After recital F – Am 6
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: Fa. whereas hybrid threats against the EU are not limited to its eastern flank, but also directly affect its southern flank, including the Mediterranean, North Africa, the Sahel and the external borders of southern Member States; whereas the security of the EU’s southern flank is inseparable from the territorial integrity, sovereignty and national security of the Member States concerned;
